exposure: maternal peripheral blood platelet-to-white blood cell ratio (PLT/WBC)
maternal peripheral blood white blood cell count (WBC)
cohort: The study included 400 patients with preterm birth (193 non-HCA, 207 HCA) and 87 full-term pregnancies as controls.
finding: Maternal platelet count and PLT/WBC ratio were significantly increased in the HCA group and demonstrated diagnostic value for HCA-related spontaneous preterm birth.
cross-section timing: Maternal peripheral blood was collected at the time of preterm birth (for HCA and non-HCA groups) and during full-term pregnancy (for controls).
